name: Wideawake Warden Cass

intro.text: I've watched the wideawake fair come back to this island, one colony at a time, and I've been standing here ever since. You'll want to impress me.

win: Well. That's a good fight. The terns would be proud, and they are never proud.
after: Wideawake terns spend years at sea after fledging and then come back to nest on Ascension. They never stop calling, which is where the name comes from.
